label: Born in first quarter of VIII Century
description: Debated whether born in Kufa or Tus; accepted born in Tus while father was in Khorasan.

sources.quote: it may be said that Jabir Ibn Hayyan was born in first quarter of VIII Century .

label: Died 200/815
description: Text states 200/815 B.C., context implies A.D.

sources.quote: Jabir Ibn Hayyan (200/815 B . C.) is described as a famous chemist and all -rounder Islamic philosopher .

label: Father supported Abbasids
description: Father supported Abbasids in events resulting in collapse of Umayyad Dynasty.

sources.quote: he supported Abbasids in the events that were resulted in collapse of Umayyad Dynasty in VIII Century.

label: Geber corpus emerged in West
description: Entire corpus of Geber came up in XIII and XIV centuries in the West.

sources.quote: It is understood that the entire corpus of Geber came up in XIII and XIV centuries in the West undertook very significant roles in six centuries development of chemistry .
